title: The Seven-Day Adventure
content:
Emma loves traveling. One Monday morning, she looks at her calendar and smiles.

“I have a whole week for an adventure!” she says.

## Monday

On Monday, Emma packs her suitcase. At **nine o’clock in the morning**, she puts clothes, shoes, and her camera inside.

At **half past ten**, she checks her passport.

“Everything is ready!” she says.

## Tuesday

On Tuesday, Emma goes to the airport.

Her flight is at **quarter past eight in the morning**.

She arrives at the airport at **seven o’clock**, two hours before her flight.

At **eight fifteen**, she gets on the plane.

“Goodbye, home!” Emma says.

## Wednesday

On Wednesday, Emma arrives in London.

It is **half past nine in the morning**.

She takes a taxi to her hotel and checks in.

At **twelve o’clock**, she has lunch at a small restaurant.

In the afternoon, at **three o’clock**, she visits Big Ben.

## Thursday

On Thursday, Emma wakes up early.

It is **quarter to seven**.

She has breakfast at **seven thirty** and leaves the hotel at **eight o’clock**.

At **quarter past nine**, she visits a famous museum.

In the evening, she walks around the city and takes many photos.

## Friday

On Friday, Emma takes a train to a small town.

The train leaves at **twenty past ten**.

She looks out of the window and enjoys the beautiful countryside.

At **half past twelve**, she arrives.

“This place is wonderful!” she says.

## Saturday

On Saturday, Emma has a busy day.

At **ten o’clock in the morning**, she goes sightseeing.

At **quarter past one**, she has lunch.

Later, at **quarter to five**, she visits a beautiful park.

At night, she has dinner at **eight o’clock**.

## Sunday

On Sunday, Emma prepares to go home.

Her flight is at **six PM**.

She arrives at the airport at **four thirty in the afternoon**.

While waiting for her flight, Emma looks at the photos from her trip.

“It was an amazing week,” she thinks.

At **six o’clock**, Emma gets on the plane.

She smiles and says:

“Goodbye, London. See you again someday!”

And her seven-day adventure comes to an end.
